title: Reading Drill — The Return of the Bottle Crate
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: The Return of the Bottle Crate
passages.body:
**A** A shop supplied drinks in reusable bottles but found that the bottles often came back one at a time. The manager tried lending small crates so customers could keep empties together between visits.

**B** Staff expected a higher return rate immediately. Instead, the first sign of a change was that empty bottles were less often damaged because they no longer rolled loose inside shopping bags.

**C** The crates could be returned to a different shop when the two stores shared a delivery route. A coloured sticker on each crate made this possible without having to record the customer's name.
